def: Google's open-source vector search library, built mainly for maximum inner product search, whose anisotropic quantization penalizes error parallel to a vector more than error orthogonal to it.
practice: A quantization-first alternative to graph indexes such as HNSW; it also supports Euclidean distance, and its paper (Guo et al., ICML 2020) reported state-of-the-art results on ANN-Benchmarks.
